products.name: Organic Tomato Seeds
products.description: Certified organic tomato seeds producing juicy, flavorful fruits perfect for salads and sauces. Each packet contains approximately 50 seeds with a high germination rate.

products.name: Basil Seeds
products.description: Classic Genovese basil seeds ideal for kitchen gardens, containers, and companion planting with tomatoes. Aromatic leaves ready for harvest in just 6-8 weeks.

products.name: Sunflower Seeds
products.description: Giant sunflower seeds that grow up to 2 metres tall with stunning golden blooms. A favourite for children's gardens and attracting pollinators.

products.name: Hot Pepper Seeds
products.description: A spicy mix of cayenne, jalapeño, and habanero pepper seeds for heat lovers. Thrives in warm, sunny positions and produces abundantly throughout summer.

products.name: Lavender Seeds
products.description: English lavender seeds producing fragrant purple flower spikes beloved by bees and butterflies. Drought-tolerant and perfect for borders, paths, and Mediterranean-style gardens.

products.name: Carrot Seeds
products.description: Sweet Nantes variety carrot seeds producing crisp, tender roots ideal for fresh eating and juicing. Sow successionally from spring to midsummer for a continuous harvest.

products.name: Tulip Bulbs Mix
products.description: A vibrant mix of 25 premium tulip bulbs in red, yellow, pink, and purple shades. Plant in autumn for a spectacular spring display in beds, borders, or containers.

products.name: Daffodil Bulbs
products.description: Pack of 20 classic golden daffodil bulbs that naturalise beautifully year after year. One of the earliest spring flowers, ideal for planting under trees and in lawns.

products.name: Crocus Bulbs
products.description: A cheerful collection of 30 crocus corms in purple, white, and yellow that herald the arrival of spring. Perfect for rock gardens, lawns, and container displays.

products.name: Hyacinth Bulbs
products.description: Intensely fragrant hyacinth bulbs in a mix of blue, pink, and white. Pack of 10 bulbs, ideal for beds, pots, and indoor forcing during winter months.

products.name: Allium Bulbs
products.description: Striking ornamental allium bulbs producing large, globe-shaped purple flower heads on tall stems. Pack of 8 bulbs that make a dramatic architectural statement in any garden.

products.name: Stainless Steel Pruning Shears
products.description: Professional-grade bypass pruning shears with razor-sharp stainless steel blades and comfortable non-slip grip. Ideal for clean cuts on stems up to 20mm in diameter.

products.name: Ergonomic Garden Spade
products.description: Full-size garden spade with an ergonomic D-grip handle and carbon steel blade for effortless digging. The ash wood shaft provides excellent shock absorption and durability.

products.name: Steel Garden Rake
products.description: Heavy-duty 14-tine steel garden rake for levelling soil, removing debris, and preparing seed beds. Fitted with a sturdy fibreglass handle for lightweight yet strong performance.

products.name: 10L Watering Can
products.description: Durable 10-litre galvanised steel watering can with a detachable brass rose for gentle watering. Classic design with a balanced handle for comfortable one-handed pouring.

products.name: Premium Garden Gloves
products.description: Breathable yet thorn-resistant garden gloves with reinforced leather palms and flexible knit backing. Available in medium and large sizes for a comfortable, secure fit.

products.name: Hand Transplanter
products.description: Narrow-blade hand transplanter with depth markings for precise planting of seedlings and bulbs. Features a rust-resistant aluminium alloy blade and soft-touch ergonomic handle.

products.name: Terracotta Pot 30cm
products.description: Classic Italian-style terracotta pot with a 30cm diameter and drainage hole. Naturally porous clay regulates moisture and provides excellent root aeration for healthy plants.

products.name: Glazed Ceramic Planter
products.description: Elegant hand-glazed ceramic planter in deep ocean blue with a glossy finish and matching saucer. 25cm diameter, frost-resistant, and perfect for patios or indoor display.

products.name: Hanging Basket with Liner
products.description: 35cm powder-coated wrought iron hanging basket complete with a natural coco fibre liner and hanging chains. Ideal for trailing petunias, fuchsias, and strawberry plants.

products.name: Raised Bed Kit 120x80cm
products.description: Easy-to-assemble raised bed kit made from FSC-certified treated pine, measuring 120x80x30cm. Perfect for growing vegetables, herbs, and flowers with improved drainage and soil control.

products.name: Seed Starting Tray 72 Cells
products.description: Professional 72-cell seed starting tray with a clear humidity dome and bottom drainage. Reusable BPA-free plastic designed for optimal seedling germination and root development.

products.name: Universal Potting Mix 50L
products.description: Premium all-purpose potting mix enriched with perlite and slow-release nutrients for up to 6 weeks. Suitable for indoor plants, outdoor containers, and garden beds.

products.name: Cactus & Succulent Mix 10L
products.description: Fast-draining specialty soil blend with sand, perlite, and fine gravel formulated for cacti and succulents. Prevents root rot by ensuring excellent aeration and minimal water retention.

products.name: Orchid Bark Substrate 5L
products.description: Premium-grade pine bark substrate in medium chips specially graded for Phalaenopsis and other epiphytic orchids. Provides optimal air circulation around roots for healthy growth.

products.name: Seed Starting Soil 20L
products.description: Ultra-fine, sterile seed starting mix with a light texture that promotes strong root development and even germination. Free from weed seeds and pathogens for the healthiest seedlings.

products.name: Organic Universal Fertilizer 5kg
products.description: Certified organic granular fertilizer made from composted plant materials and natural minerals. Feeds all garden plants gently for up to 3 months while improving soil biology.

products.name: Rose & Flower Fertilizer 1kg
products.description: Specially formulated fertilizer with high potassium content to promote abundant, vibrant blooms on roses and flowering plants. Apply every 4-6 weeks throughout the growing season.

products.name: Lawn Fertilizer 10kg
products.description: Professional-grade lawn fertilizer with a balanced NPK ratio for thick, lush green grass. Covers up to 250 square metres and includes iron for enhanced colour without excessive growth.

products.name: Tomato & Vegetable Fertilizer 1L
products.description: Concentrated liquid fertilizer with added calcium and magnesium to prevent blossom end rot and boost vegetable yields. Dilute and apply weekly during the growing season for best results.
